steps.title: Login to ZSSF Employer Portal
steps.title_sw: Ingia kwenye Mfumo wa Mwajiri wa ZSSF
steps.instruction: Go to the ZSSF employer portal and log in with your employer registration number and password
steps.instruction_sw: Nenda kwenye mfumo wa mwajiri wa ZSSF na ingia ukitumia nambari yako ya usajili wa mwajiri na nenosiri

steps.title: Go to Contribution Submission
steps.instruction: On the employer dashboard, click on 'Contributions' then select 'Submit Monthly Contribution'
steps.instruction_sw: Kwenye dashibodi ya mwajiri, bonyeza 'Michango' kisha chagua 'Wasilisha Mchango wa Kila Mwezi'
steps.expected_screen: ZSSF employer dashboard with navigation menu

steps.title: Upload Employee List
steps.instruction: Download the contribution template, fill it with your employees' names, ZSSF numbers, and salaries, then upload the completed file
steps.instruction_sw: Pakua kielezo cha mchango, kijaze na majina ya wafanyakazi wako, nambari za ZSSF, na mishahara, kisha pakia faili iliyokamilika
steps.expected_screen: Contribution submission form with upload option
steps.success_indicator: Employee list uploaded and validated successfully

steps.title: Review and Confirm Contributions
steps.instruction: Review the contribution summary showing total employees and total contribution amount, then click 'Confirm'
steps.instruction_sw: Kagua muhtasari wa mchango unaoonyesha jumla ya wafanyakazi na kiasi cha jumla cha mchango, kisha bonyeza 'Thibitisha'
steps.success_indicator: Contribution confirmed and payment invoice generated

steps.title: Pay Contributions
steps.instruction: Use the generated invoice number to make payment via your bank or mobile money. Upload the payment receipt to complete the process
steps.instruction_sw: Tumia nambari ya ankara iliyotengenezwa kufanya malipo kupitia benki yako au pesa za simu. Pakia risiti ya malipo kukamilisha mchakato
steps.expected_screen: Payment instructions page with invoice number
steps.success_indicator: Payment receipt uploaded and contributions marked as paid
